normalization_plan.reason: buyTokens parameter only used to address the token recipient inside buyTokens
local copy of msg.value used only to size the purchase in buyTokens
transient token amount consumed within buyTokens before delivery
_weiAmount parameter exists solely to compute the bonus/amount in _getTokenAmount
bonus percentage is a temporary selector for the bonus tier inside _getTokenAmount
resultAmount is the accumulator mutated by the unchecked addition flagged as the arithmetic unsafe operation
_to is only used as the destination of the .transfer Ether payout in withdrawFunds
_value is only used as the amount of the .transfer Ether payout in withdrawFunds
value is a scaled temporary used only for the balance update inside transferTokensFromSpecialAddress
_investor is only written into the kyc mapping by kycPass
_spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve
_addedValue only feeds the allowance increment in increaseApproval
_subtractedValue only feeds the allowance decrement in decreaseApproval
_newOwner is only assigned to the candidate state variable in transferOwnership
_newManager is only assigned to the manager state variable in setManager
